knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: Living documents kept in step with the repositories they describe.

empty.title: No topics yet
empty.description: A topic names one document and the repositories it follows.

gate.lockedDescription: Upgrade to {plan} to keep documentation in step with your repositories.
gate.lapsedDescription: Reactivate the subscription to create or change knowledge topics.

card.externallyEditedHint: Someone changed this page in Notion. Scibly will not overwrite it.

destination.title: Where documents live
destination.description: Pick the Notion page that “Scibly Knowledge” should be created under. Every topic's document becomes a sub-page of it.
destination.notConnected: Connect Notion in integration settings first, and allow Scibly to insert and update content.
destination.empty: No pages are shared with Scibly. Share one in Notion, then reload.

form.description: What the document is about, and which repositories it follows.
form.name: Name
form.aboutHint: A few sentences on what belongs in this document. This is what decides whether a pull request is filed here, so the more concrete the better.
form.aboutPlaceholder: Decisions about how we authenticate — session handling, token lifetimes, the SSO providers we support and why.
form.repositoriesHint: The topic follows changes in the repositories you pick — each one fully, unless you narrow it to folders or a pattern.
form.repositoriesEmpty: No repositories. Connect GitHub in integration settings first.
form.repositoriesUnreachable: Marked repositories are no longer in the connected GitHub installation. Remove them to save.
form.maintainersHint: They review what the sync suggests. You can add them later.
form.maintainersUnavailable: Members could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
form.globInvalid: “{glob}” is not a path inside the repository. Drop the leading slash and any “..”.
form.repositoriesUnavailable: Repositories could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
form.repositoriesMax: A topic can follow at most {max} repositories.
form.globMax: A repository can be narrowed to at most {max} path globs.
form.repositoriesInvalid: One of the path patterns is not valid. Remove it and try again.
form.updatedDocumentLeft: Topic saved. Its Notion page was changed outside Scibly, so Scibly left it alone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete topic?
deleteDialog.description: "{name}" will be removed. The pull requests already collected stay with the organization, and its Notion page is left alone.

knowledge.loadFailed: Topics could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

detail.loadFailed: This topic could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

feed.insightsHint: What the discussions below settled. Maintainers review these before they reach the document.
feed.noInsights: No insights yet. They appear once a collected pull request has been read.
feed.sourcesHint: Everything this topic has read, and what came of each one.
feed.noSources: Nothing collected yet. A first sync looks back two weeks; anything merged since then appears here.
feed.readFailed: {count} pull request(s) could not be read. Sync again to retry.
feed.activityHint: Every step the sync took for this topic — collecting, triage, and reading.
